div.ab: Regem Anglie singulari maiestate regni sui dominum esse, manifeste ueritatis intuitus et singulorum denique cognouit effectus.

div.ab: That the king of England is lord of his kingdom with singular majesty, the view of manifest truth and, lastly, the experience of each person has made known.
